text: Confirmed and filed #6587: VFP9 `COPY FILE *.bin TO *.bak` copies two matches including exact embedded-NUL bytes; Copperfin produces no .bak files. Used expression resolvers returning wildcard patterns to isolate this from #6583 bare operand parsing; current path materializes one literal snapshot, not pattern matches. Docs explicitly give wildcard `COPY FILE *.PRG TO *.BAK`. Open, owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved; no production edits.
